name: Tip Tracker: Server Income
description:
Know what you really make. Tip Tracker is a private tip tracker and shift log for people who work for tips. Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash, card — and see your real hourly rate the moment you save it.

WHAT IT DOES
Most apps stop at "how much did you make tonight". This tip tracker answers the harder question: what did that shift actually pay you per hour, after you tipped out? Enter your hours and your server tips, add your tip-out and your base wage, and it does the arithmetic you would otherwise be doing in your head at 1am.

• Log a shift in seconds — hours, cash tips, card tips, tip-out
• Your effective hourly rate: base wage + tips − tip-out, over hours worked
• Track income by shift, by week and by month
• Watch your hourly rate trend across shifts as one smoothed line
• Find your best nights — which shifts actually pay, by day of the week
• A full income history you can browse as a list or on a calendar
• More than one job, each with its own wage and its own numbers
• Export your shift log as a CSV whenever you want it
• Optional tip percentage, if you log your sales

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add where you work, and your base wage if you get one.
2. At the end of the night, open the app and enter your hours and your tips.
3. Save. You immediately see what you kept and what it worked out to per hour.
4. Come back next shift. Two shifts in, you can compare them.

THE AFTER-MIDNIGHT RULE
A shift that ends at 1:40am belongs to the night that started yesterday. Between midnight and 6am this tip log files a new entry under the previous day automatically — so your week totals, your income tracker and your day-of-week stats stay right without you thinking about it. The date is always editable.

WHY THE HOURLY RATE
Two hundred dollars is a great night on a five-hour Friday and an ordinary one on a twelve-hour double. Totals alone can't tell you which shifts to ask for, which sections pay, or whether the new schedule is actually better. An hourly rate can. That is why this server tip tracker leads with the rate on every screen and draws the trend of it over time.

YOUR HISTORY, KEPT PROPERLY
Every shift you log stays. Browse your server tips as a running list or as a month calendar where the busier nights sit darker, so a season's shape is visible at a glance. Weekly and monthly summaries add up hours, tips and what you kept, and each one carries its own rate so you can compare a slow February against a good July honestly. Nothing expires and nothing is trimmed.

WHO IT IS FOR
Servers and waitresses. Bartenders and barbacks. Baristas, hosts and bussers. Delivery drivers and couriers. Hair stylists, barbers and nail techs. Valets, bellhops, casino dealers, catering and banquet staff. Anyone whose income arrives as tips and whose paycheck never tells the whole story.

A REAL INCOME LOG, FASTER THAN A SPREADSHEET
Built for a phone in a server station, not a desk. Every number in this income tracker is one you typed: nothing is estimated, nothing is averaged against other people, and nothing is filled in for you. The tip log adds it up and shows you the result — that's the whole product.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Your data stays on your device — no account, no cloud. There is no sign-in and no server, so your shift log works with no signal at all: a basement bar, a walk-in, a parking garage. Your shifts are never uploaded anywhere. No ads, ever.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
Your shifts, your jobs, your rates and your whole history live in one app that opens instantly and works anywhere. Pick up a second job and its numbers stay separate from the first. Export a CSV of your own records whenever you want one — it is your data and it stays yours. This shift log is quick enough to fill in while you are cashing out, and detailed enough that it still makes sense a year later when you are looking back at a whole season of server tips.

For your personal records only — not tax, accounting, or financial advice.

It began as a companion for servers, and it still is the fastest way to take an
order at the table. But Vrestro can now run the whole outlet on its own — take
the order, print it to the kitchen, settle the bill and read the day's numbers,
with no computer on the counter at all.

NEW: MOBILE-ONLY MODE

Run your restaurant entirely from a handset. No desktop till, no print server,
no extra hardware beyond the thermal printers you already own.

• Print straight from the phone. Kitchen tickets (KOT), bar tickets (BOT),
estimate bills and tax invoices go directly to your network thermal printers
over Wi-Fi — the phone talks to the printer itself.
• Station-wise routing. Every item reaches the right printer on its own:
kitchen, bar, or any station you set up. Starters to the kitchen, drinks to
the bar, in one confirm.
• Set printers up in the app. Give each station its printer, send a test print,
and see immediately whether it worked — without touching a computer.
• Reprint when paper jams. Any ticket can be sent again from the kitchen board.

ORDERS AND TABLES

• Send orders to the kitchen in a few taps — no paper tickets, no misread
handwriting.
• See which tables are occupied and what each one owes, updated live.
• Add to a running table without reprinting what the kitchen already has.
• Browse by category, pick variations and add-ons, and attach a guest's special
request to a dish or to the whole order.
• Move an order between tables, split off items, or cancel a line — the kitchen
is told either way.

THE KITCHEN, ON SCREEN

• A live ticket board: what has been sent, what is being cooked, what is ready.
• Mark items done as they leave the pass, so servers know without asking.

SETTLE THE BILL

• Cash, card, bank transfer, cheque, FonePay QR and NepalPay QR — including
split payments across more than one method.
• Sell on credit to a known customer, take a part payment now and record the
rest as due.
• Add a discount, add a customer on the spot, and print the invoice.

CUSTOMERS AND CREDIT

• Keep a customer list with contact details and credit limits.
• See at any moment what is owed to you and what you owe your suppliers.
• Collect a due and print a receipt for it.

RUN THE BUSINESS FROM THE SAME APP

• A dashboard for the shift: sales, expenses, net income, transactions, and
what is running low in the store — for today, yesterday, the last 7 days, or
any date range you pick.
• Reports on sales, items, staff performance and more.
• Manage the menu itself: items, prices, categories, units and printing
stations, all editable on the phone.
• Track stock, record purchases, keep a vendor ledger, and get told when an
item is nearly out.
• Shift summaries showing what each member of staff took.
• Staff accounts with per-screen permissions — a server sees the tables and
the kitchen board, and nothing they do not need.

BUILT FOR A REAL FLOOR

• Keeps working when the internet does not. On mobile-only mode the phone and
the printer are on the same local network, so a dropped connection does not
stop service.
• Live sync across devices, so two servers never see different tables.
• A built-in guide that opens the screen it has just explained.
• Light and dark, and readable in a bright dining room.

Vrestro is used by restaurants, cafés, bars and takeaways. Whether you run one
handset or a floor full of them, it is built to be faster than paper and quieter
than a queue at the till.

description:

* Smart Substitutions & Precision Scaling
Get instant ingredient swap suggestions—like substituting light rum for gin—with notes on how flavor profiles change.

* Custom Recipe Builder & Shared Shopping Lists
Create your own unique recipes or tweak existing classics to match your personal taste.

name: Gigvault: Concert Tracker
description:
Gigvault is the concert tracker for live music obsessives. Log every concert you've ever been to, track every setlist, and build a complete history of your gigs. It's the only concert tracker that gives you a Concert Wrapped after every single show — your stats, your top artists, your cities, your AI Music Identity, all in one shareable card.

YOUR CONCERT DIARY
Gigvault is a concert diary that fills itself in: a running concert list that grows with every night out, with the setlist attached to every show. Backfill the gigs you went to years ago or start with tonight — your concert diary stays searchable and stays yours.

TRACK EVERY SHOW
Add a concert in seconds: artist, venue, city, date. Rate it, write down what you remember, tag the friends who were there. Your gig history stays searchable and sortable, from last night back to your very first show.

EVERY SETLIST, EVERY BAND
See what was actually played. Gigvault brings up the setlist for the night you were there, song by song, so you can settle the argument about whether they really opened with that one.

CONCERT WRAPPED
After every show you get a Wrapped: concerts counted, hours of live music, top artists, venues and cities, plus your AI Music Identity. Share it as an image or keep it to yourself.

FREE, WITH NO LOGGING LIMIT
Logging your concerts costs nothing. No ads, no credit card, no cap. Other apps let you log ten shows and then put up a paywall. On Gigvault you add your tenth, your hundredth and your thousandth concert without paying a cent.

EVERY GENRE
Rock, pop, metal, techno, hip-hop, jazz, classical, indie, punk, country, EDM — Gigvault works for every genre. Club show, arena night, open air or opera: if you were there, it goes in your concert diary.

PHOTOS & MEMORIES
Attach photos and videos to each concert. Ticket stubs, wristbands, the blurry front-row shot — all filed with the show they belong to instead of lost in your camera roll.

IMPORT YOUR HISTORY
Been going to gigs for twenty years? Add your past concerts in bulk instead of typing them in one at a time, so your whole concert list is there from day one.

FESTIVAL TRACKING
Log a festival as a single entry with every set inside it. Days, stages, clashes, and the acts you actually made it to.

SOCIAL HUB
Follow other concert-goers, compare gig counts, and find out who else was at the same show. Concert groups let you and your friends keep one shared history of the shows you go to together.

GLOBAL DATABASE
Artists, venues, cities and festivals worldwide, each with its own page. Use Gigvault as a concert tracker for the shows you've seen and as a reference for the ones you're deciding on.

GIGVAULT PRO
Unlimited photo and video uploads, AI Music Identity, shared concert groups, and advanced stats on your listening and going-out habits.

PHOTOGRAPHER PRO
For people who shoot shows: high-resolution uploads, larger galleries per concert, and tools built around a working photo archive rather than a phone camera roll.

PRIVACY
Your concert history is yours. You choose what is public and what stays private, and we don't sell your data to anyone.

AVAILABLE LANGUAGES
English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Dutch, Finnish, Polish, Czech, Norwegian, Italian, Swedish and Danish.

WHO IT'S FOR
People who still have the ticket from 2011 in a drawer. People who plan holidays around a tour date. People who want to know how many times they've actually seen that band. If you've ever tried to reconstruct your gig history from old emails and camera roll dates, this is the concert diary you were missing.

Download Gigvault. Log it now. Live it forever.

Place a Toggl Track widget on your Home Screen to see your timer running — and to start or stop a time entry.

Your time is safe with us - phone, desktop or web, your time is seamlessly synced and kept safe between all of your devices.

Want more control? Add and edit all of your time manually and make sure that every second of your time is accounted for. This feature is optional and it's accessible from the Settings menu.

No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync with your account (and the rest of your devices) - your time (and money!) is not going anywhere.

◽ Is the app free?
Yes, Toggl Track for Android is completely free for you to use. Not only that, there are no ads at all - ever!

You betcha (and we'd love to hear from you)! You can send us feedback directly from the app - look for the 'Submit Feedback' in the Settings menu.

And that's Toggl Track - a time tracker so simple that you'll actually use it and get things done! Track important tasks, use reports to see how you spend your time and boost your productivity. name: Geo Tracker - GPS tracker
description:
If you are looking for an excellent GPS tracker, that can work with Open Street Maps or Google, love outdoor activities, or travel - this is the app for you!


Record GPS tracks of your trips, analyze statistics, and share them with your friends!


Geo Tracker can help:
• Making the way back in an unfamiliar area without getting lost;
• Sharing your route with friends;
• Using someone else's route from GPX, KML or KMZ file;
• Marking important or interesting points on your way;
• Locating a point on the map, if you know its coordinates;
• Showing off colorful screenshots of your accomplishments on social networks.


You can view the tracks and the surrounding area in the application using a scheme from OSM or Google, as well as satellite images from Google or Mapbox - this way you will always have the most detailed map of the area anywhere worldwide. The map areas you view are saved to your phone and remain available offline for a while (this works best for OSM maps and Mapbox's satellite images). To record and calculate track statistics only a GPS signal is needed - the Internet is only required to download map images.


While driving, you can turn on the navigation mode, in which the map automatically rotates in the direction of travel, which greatly simplifies navigation.


The application can record tracks while being in the background (on many devices, this requires additional configuration in the system - be careful! The instructions for these settings are available in the application). Power consumption in background mode is greatly optimized - on average, the phone's charge is enough for a whole day of recording. There's also an economy mode - you can turn it on in the app settings.


Geo Tracker calculates the following statistics:
• Distance traveled and recording time;
• Max and average speed on the track;
• Time and average speed in motion;
• Min and max altitude on the track, altitude difference;
• Vertical distance, ascent and speed;
• Min, max, and average slope.


Also, there are detailed charts of speed and elevation data available.


Recorded tracks can be stored as GPX, KML, and KMZ files, so they can be used in other well-known applications like Google Earth or Ozi Explorer. Tracks are stored locally on your device and are not transferred to any servers.


The app does not make money from ads or your personal data. To support the development of the project, a voluntary donation can be made in the application.


Useful tips & tricks to solve common GPS issues with your smartphone:
• If you start the tracking please wait a bit until the GPS signal is found.
• Restart your smartphone and make sure that you have a "clear view" of the sky before you start (no disturbing objects like high buildings, forests, etc.).
• The reception conditions are permanently changing because they are influenced by the following factors: weather, season, positioning of satellites, areas with bad GPS coverage, high buildings, forests, etc.).
• Go to phone settings, choose "Location" and activate it.
• Go to phone settings, choose "Date & time" and activate the following options: "Automatic date & time" and "Automatic time zone". It may occur that it takes longer until the GPS signal is found if your smartphone is set to the wrong time zone.
• Deactivate the airplane mode in your phone settings.


If none of these tips & tricks helped to solve your issues, deinstall the app and reinstall it again.
Be aware that Google uses in their Google Maps app not only the GPS data but also additional data of the current location from surrounding WLAN networks and/or mobile networks.


More answers to frequent questions and solutions for popular issues can be found on the website: https://geo-tracker.org/faq/?lang=en

To meet different customer requirements and specific system configurations to send data from the ECM to the ELD and then to upload and synchronize the ELD with the server, Driver Log is packaged with multiple hardware solutions that plug into the vehicle ECM and sends the J1939 and J1708 protocols to the ELD via Bluetooth or WIFI, learn more by clicking this link http://www.wlius.com/hos

• Automatically uploads to the server via cellular or WIFI every event in real time, so the dispatcher has a complete real time visibility of the drivers’ status within the HOS shift and cycle.
• No data can be lost – the data on the Android device synchronizes real time with the server and is being backed up on the server. In case that the Android device is broken or lost, the driver’s data is downloaded from the server automatically to the new Android device.
• The identical logs displayed on the driver’s Android device are also displayed and printable on the management console.
• DriverLog is fully integrated with Wireless Links Fleet.Net GPS based fleet management system or if you already have a fleet management system DriverLog can be an independent standalone system.
• For integrators DriverLog can be fully integrated into any 3rd party fleet management and/or dispatch application.
• DriverLog has the option to send real time GPS data to a fleet management system, saving the need for a separate GPS unit

description:
Are you tired of writing your mileage logbook by hand? Then you've come to the right place. TripTracker is the only mobile driver’s logbook that is automatically written by using GPS, Bluetooth-Detection, reverse Geocoding or OBDII data. In addition, you can also manage vehicle costs to keep an overview.

TripTracker is law conform so that your mileage logbook is also accepted by most public authorities.

* * Features **
* SSL Encryption
* OBD2 Interface
* Bluetooth Start/Stop
* Automatic tracking
* Excel and PDF Export (In-App-Product)
* WISO Export (In-App-Product)
* INtex Export (In-App-Product)
* KML-Support (In-App-Product)
* OBDII Displays and Graphs (In-App-Product)
* GPS Tracking
* Geocoding
* Version control system
* Sync (In-App-Product)
* Web interface
* Calendar
* Car cost management
* Various Graphs and Diagrams
* Backup functionality


** OBDII **
TripTracker is able to connect directly to your car so that it can read the odometer and calculate the distance traveled. This allows TripTracker to write your mileage logbook 100% synchronized with your car. In addition, various parameters and the error memory can be read.
To use this feature, you don’t need to modify your car! You just require a Bluetooth adapter which is plugged in to the cars OBDII interface. Installation is very easy since in most modern cars the OBDII interface is directly beneath the steering wheel.
For more information please read here: https://triptracker.app/obdii
NOTE: Wifi Adapters are not supported anymore due to some Android limitations.


** Security **
TripTracker provides complete and correct data collection. The mileage logbook’s integrity is ensured by various hash and encryption algorithm. Each entry has its own checksum to guarantee that it isn't changed afterwards or outside of TripTracker. The generated PDF can be signed by one of our servers to ensure that it can't be modified.

** Privacy **
In contrary to most other systems all the collected data is your property. It is not stored somewhere abroad on a Server or a Cloud. The mileage logbook is on your phone in a local high performance SQL database.
TripTracker does not sell or analyze your mileage logbook!!

** Backend **
TripTracker has a powerful synchronization mechanism that allows you to collect and edit your mileage logbook across multiple devices. There is also a web interface which allows you to analyze your data on a PC or Mac.

Privacy policy:
https://triptracker.app/privacy

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

Bridge Scale Axle Calculation – Instantly compute steering, drive, and trailer weights as you roll over bridge scales

Tandem Hole Guidance – Get recommendations for sliding trailer tandems to the correct hole after scaling

name: Sygic GPS Truck & Caravan
description:
High-quality GPS navigation designed for professional drivers & their large vehicles. Trusted by 6+ million drivers & many of the world's leading delivery fleets. Smart route planning and navigation, 3D offline maps, realtime traffic and precise ETA, speed cameras warnings and an easy-to-use interface provide an effective sat nav experience.

The app offers navigation specially tailored to specifications of: truck / HGV / RV / caravan / motorhome / camper / van / bus / car/ or car with trailer.

1. Customized routes for vehicle type, size & weight
Enter your vehicle type, size, weight, number of trailers & other settings. The app calculates the route according to set parameters and prevents run-ins with hazards like low bridges or narrow streets.

2. Advanced vehicle settings (including HAZMAT)
Set your load settings (general HAZMAT, water pollutants, explosives) and navigate on eligible and safe roads only. Set preferences such as right turns, avoidance of toll roads & ferries, or arrival with the destination on the right side.

3. 3D offline maps (no internet needed) with free map updates
Never get lost waiting for a signal again. Offline maps guarantee you'll always find anything you need – even without an internet connection. They come in handy when driving abroad or in areas with poor signal coverage. We update the map data multiple times per year.

4. Realtime traffic & Speed cameras
Add Realtime traffic to avoid delays on the road, have precise ETA information, and deliver on time. Speed cameras warn you when a mobile or fixed speed cameras are on your route. Head-Up display (HUD) projects optimized navigation instructions onto the car's windshield.

5. Thousands of truck / caravan related POIs
Navigate to thousands of reliable and detailed points of interest (POIs) from trusted sources, such as truck stops, weight stations, parking lots, campsites, hotels, restaurants, etc. Fill up at the best price with realtime information about fuel prices along your route.

6. Truck & caravan specific Speed limits & alerts
The sat nav app shows the current speed, the maximum allowed speed, and upcoming speed limit changes. You will get clear visual and sound alerts when you exceed the speed limit.

7. Dynamic lane assistant & Clear voice instruction
The sat nav app will guide you into the correct lane and show you the junction with highlighted lanes and exits. Voice navigation with clear & accurate driving instructions helps focus on the road ahead and frees you from checking the route on a phone display.

8. Multistop route planning & Optimization
Plan your trip and set up routes with up to 150 waypoints. Easily customize the waypoint order or choose the option "Optimize." The app will rearrange the waypoints to achieve the best efficiency.

9. Plan with Google Maps & send the route to the app (Android only)
With Sygic Truck Route Sender – a cost-free extension available in Chrome and Firefox - you can plan your route with Google Maps with up to 10 stops on your desktop. Then send the route directly to the app.

Rely on Sygic GPS Truck & Caravan Navigation, the best copilot on your routes and the most advanced sat nav on the market!

name: Organic Maps・Offline Map & GPS
description:
Organic Maps is a fast, detailed offline map and GPS navigation app for travel, hiking, trekking, and cycling adventures. Plan, import, and record routes, and enjoy smooth guidance without draining your battery or using an internet connection. Explore places and navigate safely during your outdoor adventures and travels around the world. The app offers unlimited map downloads and biweekly updates. OpenStreetMap-based, volunteer-made, privacy-first, 100% offline, and 100% free.

OFFLINE: The app works 100% offline — including search and navigation. You can explore the map and navigate without an internet connection, saving on mobile data and roaming fees. And with no background data transfers, your battery lasts much longer.

FAST: Zooming, search, and route calculations work noticeably fast.

DETAILED & UPDATED: The maps are rich in detail and refreshed twice a month to reflect real-world conditions. Unlike many well-known competitors, they include building labels, benches, hiking paths, and other helpful information.

OPENSTREETMAP-BASED: OpenStreetMap is a wiki-style world map built and maintained by millions of volunteers — locals who know their areas best. This community effort results in highly detailed maps, often more accurate than commercial ones in less-mapped regions. Organic Maps updates its data from OpenStreetMap every two weeks, keeping your maps fresh and reliable. And if you notice something missing, you can add it to OpenStreetMap and help improve the map for everyone.

PRIVACY-FIRST: We don’t collect any data or identifiers. This means there’s no risk of data leaks and no distractions like ads or noisy notifications — just a clean, private map experience.

IMPORTANT FEATURES

EXPLORE PLACES: Search by address, name, or category, discover millions of POIs, and view detailed information such as opening hours, Wikipedia articles, wheelchair accessibility, and other helpful details.

GPS NAVIGATION: Enjoy voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions. Create walking, hiking, cycling, or driving routes — including routes between cities, countries, and multiple waypoints. Find the best routes for your metro journeys and commutes. Android Auto is supported.

HIKING & CYCLING TRAILS FROM AROUND THE WORLD: Enable special map layers to discover popular hiking and cycling routes worldwide, all sourced from OpenStreetMap. Switch between layers to see colored bike and MTB routes, as well as official hiking paths.

PUBLIC TRANSPORT: See public transport route numbers at stops. Live transport schedules and routing are currently in development.

MAP STYLES: Choose map layers that fit your activity — Outdoors, Contour Lines, Hiking, Cycling, or Metro/Subway.

TRACK RECORDER: Record, import, export, and share your routes and favorite places. Supports KML, KMZ, GPX, and GeoJSON formats.

WIKIPEDIA ARTICLES: Explore Wikipedia articles for places you discover on the map. Type “?wiki” in the search to find all places with Wikipedia articles.

MAP EDITOR: Contribute to OpenStreetMap by adding missing places or editing the map directly from Organic Maps.

DARK MODE: Switch to a dark theme for comfortable viewing at night.

Try the app — it’s 100% free, ad-free, fast, and fully offline. Experience reliable GPS navigation for hiking, biking, trekking, and travel anywhere in the world! Enjoy a fast, reliable, and private map experience, and share it with others!

name: TruckingOffice ELD
description:
TruckingOffice ELD is the best choice for all professional drivers that are required to comply with the FMCSA Electronic Log Mandate. It is easy to implement even if you aren't tech savvy. The switch will give you peace of mind and keep you working.

Easy to edit your logs. After you create your logs, sometime things need to be adjusted. All logs are fully editable except driving time per FMCSA guidelines.

Plug and Play - No Installation Required

There is no installation involved. This is a simple plug and play device. You don't have to do any complicated pairing or anything. It just works.

TruckingOffice ELD is an FMCSA Certified ELD provider. Click here to view the list of approved certified ELD providers. https://eld.fmcsa.dot.gov/List

name: Drivers' Hours: HGV & Van
description:
Plan your day against EU 561/2006 drivers' hours and UK Working Time (RTD 2005) rules — in real time, on your phone, with no subscription.

Built for both classic HGV work and the newer 2.5–3.5t international vans now in scope with a tachograph. If you're a courier or delivery driver touching a tacho for the first time, this gives you the same live timers, warnings and correction flow HGV drivers already rely on.

Tap Driving, Rest, Other work or Availability and Drivers' Hours does the maths:

- Countdown to your next 45-minute break (4h30 continuous driving), with 15+30 split breaks handled in the correct order.
- Daily driving left — 9 hours, or 10 hours on your two allowed days a week.
- This week (56h) and rolling two-week (90h) driving left.
- Daily rest and weekly rest deadlines (the 6 x 24-hour rule), counting down.
- Working Time (WTD) hours this week against the 60-hour individual-week limit, with cumulative break reminders (30 min after 6h, 45 min after 9h).
- A 17-week rolling WTD average against the 48-hour limit — most apps don't track this at all.
- Clear amber and red warnings before you run out — plus optional reminders that fire even when the app is closed.

Built for UK drivers: dd/mm/yyyy dates, a 24-hour clock and plain English — not the American mm/dd that other apps get wrong.

Forgot to switch mode? Every change is a single tap to correct on the timeline.

No subscription. A one-off purchase removes ads and unlocks PDF and CSV export of your log. Live status, timers and reminders are always free.

Your driving log stays on your device — no account, no cloud, no card reader, no tachograph download. (The free tier shows ads, which use an advertising identifier.)

Important — please read
This app is a planning aid, not the legal record. Your digital tachograph card and the data downloaded from it remain the only official record of your hours. Figures here are estimates from what you enter and can differ from the tacho analysis. The Working Time 48-hour figure is a rolling average over your last 17 recorded weeks; your employer's fixed reference period (17 weeks, or 26 by agreement) may differ, so treat it as a guide. Always check the tachograph.

For 2.5–3.5t vans: this app is for jobs that are actually in scope of EU 561/2006. It does not create an exemption and it does not replace the legal check on whether the van, route and carriage type require a tachograph.

• Fast, simple and straightforward way to track your hours, expenses, tips, mileage and much more

• Set your pay period to automatically calculate how many hours you worked and your wages for each pay check

• Use the deductions and/or bonuses options to automatically calculated for pay check estimates

• Keep track of overtime hours by week/pay period/shift up to three separate overtimes

• Use the Premium/Differential Hours feature to automatically track premium rates during any times like weekends or evenings

• Use the notes section to keep track of detailed notes

• Automatic cloud backups and syncing between devices (logging in is required in to use these features)

• Upgrade to Work Log Pro to remove ads, add unlimited new jobs, and export your records

Work Log - Shift Tracker vs Work Log:
Work Log was originally created for Android in 2013 and has been continuously added to and improved since then. In 2023 Work Log - Shift Tracker was created from scratch. Creating a new app from scratch made it possible to add many features users have been requesting over the years, such as automatic cloud backups and syncing, and per shift wages.

In order to support the long term continued development of the improvement of all Work Log products and to cover the ongoing cost of cloud backups and syncing, the new business model is a subscription model. The original Work Log will not be going away, and you can continue to use it indefinitely.

description:
📚 A more flexible teaching workflow—alongside your SIS

Your school or district SIS is the official system of record. Teacher Gradebook gives you a flexible daily workspace for the teaching work behind those records: grading, assessment, attendance, lesson planning, notes, student progress, and reports.

Use it alongside the SIS your school requires. Calculate and analyze grades your way, collect assessment evidence, and prepare the information you later enter into the official system. Teacher Gradebook works independently: it does not replace or automatically sync with your SIS.

Tired of juggling spreadsheets, paper notes, calendars, and multiple SIS screens? Bring your daily classroom workflow together in one organized app.

👨‍🏫 Built by a teacher, for teachers

Teacher Gradebook was created by a classroom teacher who understands the realities of teaching. It is intuitive, visual, and flexible, so you can adapt it to your grading system without being a technology expert.

📊 Grade and assess your way

• Enter numeric grades, text, icons, and visual ratings
• Calculate simple or weighted averages
• Create custom formulas and calculated columns
• Configure weights, rounding, and reassessments
• Use rubrics, checklists, and rating scales
• Create editable rubrics with AI assistance
• Assess students individually or in teams
• Add comments and observations
• Export grades and reports to PDF or CSV

Teacher Gradebook adapts to your assessment approach instead of forcing your classroom into a rigid template. Every result remains clear, editable, and traceable.

📅 Organize your classroom

• Track attendance, absences, tardies, and incidents
• Create seating charts and take attendance directly from the chart
• Manage class schedules and non-instructional days
• Plan lessons, class sessions, and instructional units
• Add reminders and view upcoming sessions
• Keep a class journal by date, class, or student
• Store student profiles, contacts, photos, notes, and files
• Import student rosters from CSV files

Your grades, attendance, planner, journal, and student profiles share the same information, so you do not have to enter the same data repeatedly.

📈 See progress clearly

Review grades, attendance, ungraded activities, and classroom notes without rebuilding everything at the end of a grading period.

• Individual student and whole-class reports
• Grade charts and statistics
• Attendance and class journal reports
• Edit compatible grades and comments directly from the Grade Report
• Create editable AI-assisted narrative reports before exporting

🔒 Private, offline, and under your control

Your academic data is stored encrypted on your device. You can do your core classroom work without an Internet connection and protect access to the app with a password.

Student information is not stored on the developer’s servers. Optional cloud backups go directly to your own Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive account. You can also configure automatic backups and choose where your information is stored.

🎨 Make it yours

Customize colors, icons, columns, layouts, and table styles. Use light or dark mode and work comfortably on both phones and tablets.

Keep your required SIS as the official record. Use Teacher Gradebook as your personal, flexible workspace for the daily work that official grades are built on.

Spend less time managing spreadsheets and administrative tasks—and more time teaching and supporting your students.

name: Student Gradebook for Teachers
description:
Student Gradebook for Teachers is a secure, offline-first gradebook designed for educators, teachers, and instructors who need a reliable way to manage student records and calculate academic performance. Built to handle complex grading rules entirely on your device, this app streamlines classroom administrative workflows without requiring any internet connection.

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security
Your student data belongs to you. Student Gradebook for Teachers operates with zero network requirements and zero data collection. All rosters, classes, marks, and formulas are securely stored locally inside an encrypted sandbox database on your mobile device.

Local Backup
Export class lists or share data across devices using local JSON backups. All backup and share processes are executed locally using standard secure device framework protocols.

name: Grade Corner
description:

This app is an independent tool students may use to calculate and track their own grades.

=== GRADE CORNER PREMIUM

We are committed to providing every student full access to their grades without advertisements. We offer the following additional functionality to support the ongoing development of the app:

- Grade Calculator — see your true percentage including missing assignments
- Add hypothetical future assignments to see how they'd affect your grade
- Edit current assignments to plan makeup work

Important: The Grade Calculator is for estimation only and does not guarantee your final score.

=== PRIVACY & ENDORSEMENTS

Grade Corner is a member of the Student Data Privacy Consortium (SDPC) and is available for schools to endorse in Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont.

=== SUPPORTED SCHOOL DISTRICTS

- School districts using Aspen Student Information System (SIS)
- School districts using Infinite Campus
- School districts using PowerSchool

Grade Corner is an independent application and is not affiliated with, associated with, authorized by, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Follett School Solutions (Aspen Student Information System), Infinite Campus, Inc., PowerSchool Group LLC, or any school district using those systems, unless explicitly stated.

=== COMMON QUESTIONS

Q: Do I need an existing account with my school's grading system?
A: Yes. Grade Corner is a companion app — it uses your existing gradebook credentials. If you don't know yours, ask your school administrator.

Q: How often are grades updated?
A: As soon as teachers post them. When they update grades in the gradebook, you'll see the changes on your next refresh.

Q: Is this app officially supported by my school district?
A: Sometimes. Grade Corner was built independently by a parent with two kids in DC Public Schools. We're working on more official endorsements — the current list lives on our website.

=== DISCLAIMERS

Grade Corner is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Follett School Solutions (Aspen Student Information System), Infinite Campus, Inc., PowerSchool Group LLC, or any of the school districts listed above, unless otherwise stated.

name: TimerDash: Multi Timer Alarm
description:
I built TimerDash because I wanted a timer I could trust: one I could set, then reboot my phone and leave it locked until the alarm fires. And none of it should come with the usual baggage — no accounts, no ads, no subscriptions, and no tracking. The app uses the internet only for a one-time lifetime purchase through Google Play billing.

Use TimerDash for study sessions, workouts, meditation, cooking, Pomodoro sessions, or anything else that needs reliable timing.

*Run Multiple Timers & Stopwatches*
Manage multiple countdown timers and stopwatches. Name and color-code each one. Control them individually or start/stop everything at once. Reorder with up/down buttons, or tap the favorite button to pin one to the top of the list. Set a timer duration up to 99 hours with dials, or type an exact time. Save timers as color-coded presets for instant recall, and reorder them by drag-and-drop (Pro). Switch between modes with one tap: Timer ↔ Stopwatch and Single ↔ Multi.

*Repeat & Pomodoro Timers*
In Single timer mode, save a repeat or Pomodoro timer as a preset: choose the run time, the number of rings, the delay between rings, and the sound the rings play. A Pomodoro timer rings at the start and end of each break, so you know when to get back to work. Start it with one tap. After any Single timer finishes, tap Repeat to run it again.

*Home-Screen Widgets*
Pin any Multi timer or stopwatch to your home screen and run it from there. Start, pause, stop, and restart timers and stopwatches without opening the app. Mix and match timer and stopwatch widgets on your home screen.

*Alarms & Notifications That Don't Miss*
Alarms ring loudly even when the app is closed. Fade-in alarms use audio focus to cut through music. Full-screen alerts appear on the lock screen, including right after your device restarts — no unlock required!

*Long-Running Laps & Intervals*
Record laps and intervals that persist after device restarts. Stopwatches can run accurately for years. Track long-term habits and projects that can span months. Fastest and slowest laps are highlighted automatically. One-tap copy sends your lap list to the clipboard (Pro).

*Adjust Running Timers & Stopwatches*
Rename or recolor a timer or stopwatch while it's running. Flip any timer between counting down (time remaining) and counting up (time elapsed). Collapse cards into a compact view to fit more timers and stopwatches on the screen. Use +30s and −30s buttons to quickly adjust a running or paused timer.

*Customize Alarms & Vibration*
Choose a default alarm sound for all timers, or set a different sound for each one. Set alarm volume, timeout, and fade durations to suit your preferences. Toggle vibration, and choose whether alarms respect your device's Do Not Disturb setting.

*Stay Informed at a Glance*
Ongoing notifications list all scheduled timers, and count down the time remaining and ETA for the next one to finish. Timers show start time, ETA, and duration. Overtime display shows how long it's been since a timer finished. Visual alerts let you know when alarms are disabled or permissions are missing. From the menu, you can keep the screen on so running timers or stopwatches stay visible while you cook or work out.

*Buy Once, Use Forever*
Upgrade to Pro for 12 Multi timers + 12 Multi stopwatches, 50 timer presets, 100 stopwatch laps, and one-tap copy of your lap list. Pro includes all future app updates and improvements. Free version includes one Single mode timer and stopwatch, one Multi mode timer and stopwatch, 2 timer presets (normal, repeat, or Pomodoro), and 7 stopwatch laps.

name: Planit: Photo Planner
description:
In this free version, the Ephemeris feature is provided as an in-app purchase. After the purchase, it will be the same as the paid PlanIt Pro. Some screenshots listed here have Ephemeris features enabled. The free version can actually do a lot of things than you thought. It is a plan/marker file reader, a focal length estimator on the map, a DoF and panorama calculator and can even preview the aerial view for your drone. The Ephemeris feature is so highly integrated that it is hard for us to provide some of them in the free version and ask you to pay for the rest. You can see how many users give us a one-star rating simply because we didn't provide a trial. I think that's not fair. But as we said, although we didn't provide a trial, please feel free to purchase to try it. We can refund you at any time if you don't like it.

Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

description:

The Sun Ephemeris gives you the accurate position of the sun and the moon at any time for any location on earth. The Sun Ephemeris is ideal for landscape, nature, travel and outdoor photographers. It combined a map-based approach to search for any place on the planet with a compass based approach to easily find the direction of the sunset, sunrise, moonset or moonrise.

Key features
• Sunrise, Moonrise, Sunset and Moonset time and azimuth
• Live tracking of Sun and Moon position
• Sun & Moon elevation graph during the day
• Sun and Moon azimuth and elevation at any time during the day
• Use compass to find sun/moon rise/set directions
• Graphical display on a map (Standard, Satellite, Hybrid, Terrain)
• Search for places by name
• Moon distance from earth
• Moon phase and illumination
• Solor noon time, azimuth and elevation

1. Find your location

Use the map view and move it to your current position or use GPS to center the map at you exact location. You can also search for any place in the world by entering its name... Sun and Moon positions are then automatically updated using the choosen location.

2. Set desired time

Use the calendar controls to change the date and time. You can jump from one day to another or from one week to another or use the date time picker to select the date you want. Then you can use the elevation graph to adjust the time within the day. At any time, you can rewind/forward to the current date time which will activate live mode (which follows your phone's clock).

3. Find directions

Use the Compass view to get the direction to Sunrise, Sunset, Moonrise or Moonset for the selected location and date.

Enjoy the moment !

Most tools do one thing: a moodboard, or a shot list, or a sun calculator. Shoot Planner chains them into one pipeline — references to shots to locations to lighting to storyboard to gear — then follows you into the field on the day.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
The golden hour engine and the field mode are fully on-device. No signal on a canyon rim, in a basement venue, or on a plane means nothing to this app. Your shoot day does not depend on a login screen loading.

SHOT LIST
Build a shot list with priorities, descriptions, focal length and camera notes. Assign shots to a day, drag to reorder, and mark each one captured as you go.

REFERENCES AND MOODBOARD
Collect a visual moodboard per project — shoot with the camera, pull from your photo library, or paste a Pinterest, Instagram or web link and the image and title are fetched for you. Browse it as a masonry gallery and filter by tag.

REFERENCE TO SHOT, IN ONE TAP
Turn any reference into a shot, permanently linked. On set you see the inspiration image beside the shot you are taking — not buried in a different app on a different tab.

GOLDEN HOUR AND BLUE HOUR
An offline solar engine gives sunrise, sunset, the golden hour window with its exact duration, blue hour, and the sun path for every day and location in your plan. No network, no subscription wall, no waiting for a map tile.

LOCATION SCOUTING AND MAP
Geo-tag each shot and see the whole project as numbered pins in shooting order. Save access notes — parking, gate codes, permit restrictions, the walk in — and hand off to your maps app for directions.

STORYBOARD
Lay scenes out as horizontal filmstrips, drag to sequence them, and set per-shot durations with realistic travel and setup gaps between them. See whether the day actually fits before you promise it.

GEAR LIBRARY AND PACKING LIST
Keep a reusable inventory of bodies, lenses, support, power, filters and drone kit. Build a packing list per project and watch the packed progress climb. Stop arriving without the one lens the shot needed.

SHOOT MODE
The reason this is not just another planning document. One-handed, one shot at a time: the current shot with its reference image, a live golden hour countdown, a big capture button, skip and advance, and a place for on-set notes. The screen stays awake. It runs entirely offline and syncs when you are back in service.

TEMPLATES AND REMINDERS
Save any project as a template and reuse it, or start from Wedding Essentials, Location Scout or Brand Day. Set shoot-relative reminders — pack gear two hours before call — and push shoot days to your device, Google or Apple calendar.

WHO IT IS FOR
Wedding, portrait, landscape, brand and commercial photographers. Videographers and filmmakers running their own film pre-production. Solo shooters who plan properly and want the plan in their hand on the day.

BUILT FOR THE WAY SHOOT DAYS ACTUALLY GO
Your shooting schedule slips because the light moved, the location was gated, or the client added a setup. Shoot Planner is built to be edited on the day, not admired the night before. Reorder the shot list in the field, re-check the sunrise and sunset times for the new spot, mark the shots you got, and keep the photo shoot checklist honest as the day changes around you.

PRICING
Free to use, with a capped number of projects. Pro unlocks unlimited projects at $6.99/month or $59.99/year — around 28% off annually — and starts with a 7-day free trial.

Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner, shot list app, photography planner, storyboard tool, location scouting notebook, camera gear checklist and golden hour calculator — the whole shoot day pre-production workflow in one offline app.

Download Shoot Planner and walk onto your next shoot knowing exactly what you came for.

name: Stage Metronome with Setlist
description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

SETLIST FOR YOUR WHOLE SET

Build a setlist before the gig and store each song's tempo, time signature, beat pattern, and accent beats together. On stage, tap a song and everything loads instantly — no sliders, no reconfiguring under pressure. Export the setlist as a file and your bandmates can import the same settings on their own devices in seconds.

A DISPLAY YOU CAN READ FROM ACROSS THE ROOM

The beat number is large enough to read from behind a drum kit or across a stage. Full-screen mode shows only the beat number and beat lights — no controls, just a clear visual reference for the whole band. Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. Free, with no subscription required for setlist management.

name: Reprise: Karaoke Setlist
description:
You know a hundred songs. The hard part is landing on the right one before the karaoke host waves you up, without scrolling a note or a sticky binder while the night goes on without you. Reprise is your personal karaoke songbook and setlist: every song you sing, rated, tagged, and ready before you get to the bar.

WHAT DO I SING TONIGHT?
Tap Surprise Me and the wheel spins over your own songs. Filter to favorites, a genre, an artist, or a mood first and it spins over just those. Spin again or queue the pick for tonight. You decide in seconds and spend the night singing, not scrolling.

TONIGHT'S QUEUE
Line up your karaoke night in order, mark each song as sung, and rate how it went while the applause is still ringing. Your scores build a memory of what works in a real room and give you a new way to sort and filter your whole list.

A REPERTOIRE THAT KNOWS YOU
Personal vibe levels from "Getting there" to "Showstopper". Tags for duets, belters, and crowd-pleasers. Keys, tempo notes, and private reminders ("do not oversing the bridge"). Song details fill themselves in from the music catalog while you do nothing at all. Sort and filter your whole karaoke song list by score, genre, or mood to find the right song in seconds.

SONGS YOU ARE STILL LEARNING
Bungees is a wishlist for songs you want to try but have not performed yet, kept separate from your main karaoke repertoire. When you are ready to take the plunge, put it on Tonight's Queue and give it a shot with one tap.

TRACK EVERY NIGHT
The Performance Journal logs each time you sing: the venue, the type of night, the key, and quick self-ratings. It groups them by night and charts a trend, a karaoke tracker that turns practice into progress.

YOUR FRIENDS' SONGS TOO
Keep a tab of the people you sing with. Pull up their song list when it is their turn, favorite the songs you want to hear them do, and add their picks to Tonight's Queue.

DRESS IT FOR THE NIGHT
Fully art-directed looks, not color swaps, from warm marquee gold to embossed leather and lace to a photocopied punk zine, with more to choose from. Preview any look, then unlock the one that is yours.

YOURS, PRIVATELY
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your songs live on your phone and nowhere else. Free to start with up to 25 songs, scoring, tags, Tonight's Queue, and Friends, no account required. One one-time purchase unlocks an unlimited library plus import, export, print, share, and moving songs between lists. Looks are inexpensive one-time add-ons. Nothing subscribes, ever.

Your whole karaoke songbook and setlist in one place, the simple way to organize your karaoke songs and always know what to sing next. Bring your own songs. The stage is quiet, for now.

IT'S SO EASY TO USE
We created the simplest, fastest and most enjoyable way to practice guitar on a mobile device. Just tap a key and hit play!

FEATURES
☆ About 740 jam tracks in the constantly updating library. More than 400 of them are free!

1. Select a backing track (choose from the included 30 different accompaniment styles)

FOR RHYTHM AND LEAD PLAYERS
Every track has a listing of chords that are used in the track, along with scale charts - practice rhythm or lead with ease!

WHAT IS A PENTATONIC SCALE?
A pentatonic scale is one consisting of five notes, and that’s it! It is used widely in all genres and styles, and it is one of the most important scales for guitarists.
There are many forms & templates (boxes) for each key. The boxes remain unchanged, except starting positions are different.

name: How to Play in a Band
description:
This is the free version.

With this app you learn in an easy and fun way, how to play in a band.

Using animations in sync with the music that is heard, the lessons show what each instrument must do to sound a certain style of music: Rock, Blues, Funk and Latin Music.

It includes thirty lessons for Guitar, Piano/Keyboards, Electric Bass and Drums on the following contemporary music styles:

- Rock (10)
- Blues (10)
- Funk (5)
- Latin Music (5)

Each lesson is integrated by four sections.

- You will see animations that visually show you how to play your part on your instrument.

- You will see animations of the notes on the staff to help you understand how to read music in an easy way, while you play.

- You can listen the whole band to get an idea of the final result.

- You can play at a slow speed and just listen to your instrument.

- You can play it at normal speed.

- When you are ready go to the “d” section and play it while you listen the rest of the band. You have to integrate your part to the ensemble.

- While practicing you can click on the bar from which you want to repeat.

Click on the icon of the instrument you want to practice, at the bottom of the main page, to find out how to study each lesson.

The best way to approach these materials is to have a band with your friends and together practice each of the 30 lessons that this app presents. Once you have worked through the 30 lessons, you can download the app for each instrument that contains 40 additional lessons (70 in total). Just click the blue arrow icon on the main page to download the app for your favorite instrument.

If you don't have someone to play with in a band, each lesson has a “d” section where you listen to the other instruments while you play your own part. This gives you the experience of playing within an ensemble, whether you play Guitar, Piano/Keyboards, Bass, or Drums.

This app is useful not only for those who want to play in a band, but also for those who want to know what makes a musical style sound like it. What does a bass player have to do for something to sound like Blues or like Latin Music. What are the main rhythmic characteristics of Funk or Rock. What should a drummer do when asked to play a Blues rhythm or a Cha cha chá. How the guitar and piano/keyboard should interact, and so on. These are fundamental aspects for any musician, be it a performer, an arranger or a songwriter. The exercises in this app will help to have a clear idea of the aforementioned aspects.

The most common elements in each style are used and they are presented in ascending order in terms of their degree of difficulty.

name: djay - DJ App & AI Mixer
description:
*** Now with Spotify integration ***

djay transforms your Android device into a full-featured DJ system. Seamlessly integrated with Spotify and Apple Music, djay gives you direct access to millions of songs. You can perform live, remix tracks on-the-go, or let the AI-powered Automix create a seamless mix for you automatically. Whether you are a professional DJ or a beginner who just loves to play with music, djay offers you the most intuitive yet powerful DJ experience on Android.

MUSIC LIBRARY

• Spotify: Millions of tracks + your own playlists (Spotify Premium subscription)
• Apple Music: 100+ million tracks, your personal library in the cloud
• djay Music: Thousands of DJ-ready tracks from top artists and trending genres — included for free!
• TIDAL: Millions of tracks, high quality sound (TIDAL DJ Extension)
• SoundCloud: Millions of underground and premium tracks (SoundCloud Go+)
• Beatport: Millions of electronic music tracks
• Beatsource: Millions of open-format music tracks
• Local Music: all the music stored on your device

AUTOMIX

Lean back and listen to an automatic DJ mix with stunning, beat-matched transitions. The AI-powered Automix intelligently identifies rhythmic patterns including the best intro and outro sections of songs to keep the music flowing.

NEURAL MIX™ Stems

• Isolate vocals, drums, and instruments of any song in real-time

BEAT MAKER & REMIX TOOLS

• Sequencer: create beats on top of your music live
• Looper: remix your music with up to 48 loops per track
• Beat-matched sequencing of drums and samples
• Extensive content library with hundreds of loops and samples.

PRE-CUEING WITH HEADPHONES

Preview and prepare the next song through headphones. By enabling djay’s Split Output mode or by using an external audio interface you can pre-listen to songs through headphones independently from the mix that goes through the main speakers for live DJing.

DJ HARDWARE INTEGRATION

• Bluetooth MIDI: AlphaTheta DDJ-FLX-2, Hecules DJ Control Mix Ultra, Hercules DJ Control Mix, Pioneer DJ DDJ-200
• USB Midi: Pioneer DJ DDJ-WeGO4, Pioneer DDJ-WeGO3, Reloop Mixtour, Reloop Beatpad, Reloop Beatpad 2, Reloop Mixon4

ADVANCED AUDIO FEATURES

• Key lock, time-stretching, pitch shifting
• Real-time stem separation
• Mixer, Filter, and EQ controls
• 50+ Audio FX: Echo, Flanger, Crush, Gate, and more
• Crossfader FX
• Looping & Cue Points
• Automatic BPM and key detection
• Auto gain
• Colored waveforms

Note: djay for Android is designed to run on the Android operating system. However, due to the wide range of Android devices on the market, not all features of djay may be supported on every device. For example, Neural Mix requires an ARM64-based device and is not supported on older devices. Additionally, some Android devices do not support external audio interfaces, including those integrated into certain DJ controllers.

The optional PRO subscription allows you to subscribe once and use djay Pro across all your devices, including access to all PRO features, as well as 1000+ loops, samples, and visuals.

A supported streaming subscription and an internet connection are required to access songs from a streaming service in djay. No recording available for streamed songs. Neural Mix cannot be used when streaming from Apple Music or Spotify. Specific songs may not be available or accessible on your account or in your country. Streaming service availability and pricing may vary depending on country, currency and service.

name: Music Lock: Practice Tracker
description:
Less scrolling. More music.

Music Lock is a music practice tracker and app blocker for musicians who want to build a consistent practice habit. Block distracting apps during your practice window, track your time, and reach your daily goal before getting back to scrolling.

Whether you're working on guitar, piano, drums, or another instrument, Music Lock helps you make room for the practice you keep meaning to do.

How Music Lock works
1. Choose your instrument and set a daily practice goal.
2. Pick your practice time and the apps you want to block.
3. Start the practice timer and focus on your music.
4. Complete your daily goal to unlock your selected apps.

Protect your practice time
Keep selected social media, games, and other distracting apps out of the way during your scheduled practice window. When you open a blocked app, Music Lock shows a reminder to practice first.

Track your music practice
Use the practice timer to follow your progress toward your daily goal. Review your practice history, weekly minutes, and all-time stats to see how your routine is developing.

Build a daily habit
Set a manageable goal, keep your practice streak going, and make showing up part of your day. Music Lock gives you a simple structure for returning to your instrument.

Stay in control
Choose which apps to block and adjust your goal and schedule in settings. An emergency unlock is available when you need access before completing your goal.

AccessibilityService API disclosure
Music Lock uses Android's AccessibilityService API for its core app-blocking feature. With your consent and after you enable the service in Android settings, it detects which app is open, including while Music Lock is running in the background. It accesses the foreground app's package identifier to check whether that app is on your selected block list and display a blocking screen during your active practice window until your daily goal is complete.

This accessibility data is processed on your device and is not shared with third parties. Music Lock does not use the AccessibilityService API to read screen text, typed text, passwords, messages, or other content inside your apps. You can disable the service at any time in Android's Accessibility settings; app blocking requires it to be enabled. Music Lock is a practice and focus app, not an accessibility tool designed for people with disabilities.

Other permissions
Music Lock uses permission to display over other apps to show its blocking screen. If you enable notifications, it can send practice reminders.

Subscription
A subscription is required to use Music Lock after onboarding. Available plans, prices, and any eligible trial are shown before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription through Google Play.

This personalized approach makes your workouts challenging and effective, increasing your chances of reaching your fitness goals.

◆ Balanced Workouts: Adapt prioritizes muscular balance, understanding that optimal results are achieved when muscle groups work in harmony. Adapt prevents muscle imbalances and promotes overall muscle development by designing balanced workouts.

◆ Flexible Adjustments: Adapt lets users freely adjust the recommendations it creates because everyone has different preferences and limitations. Users can change the length and frequency of their workouts. They can also replace exercises or adjust their targets for calories, carbs, protein, and fat.

description:

Baby daybook: breastfeeding and bottle feeding, sleep schedule, diaper log, weight and height

The first months with your baby are a special time when every day matters for your infant's development. Parents want to understand how their baby eats, how much sleep they get, whether diapers are changed regularly, and if growth is on track. Our baby daybook helps make parenting simple, organized, and calm - from the first days of breastfeeding to establishing feeding and sleep routines.

"My Baby Tracker" is created for parents who want to easily track their baby's feeding, monitor sleep patterns, log diaper changes, and follow their infant's development.

What's inside the app:

Main screen with latest baby data
Convenient dashboard shows all important information about your baby in one place: when was the last breastfeeding or bottle feeding, how much time has passed since last sleep, when the diaper was changed, current infant weight and height. All information at your fingertips - you instantly see your baby's status.

Feeding tracker
Record every feeding: breastfeeding, bottle feeding, or formula. Mark start time and duration, which breast, amount of formula. Feeding timer helps you remember when baby ate last. Statistics show nursing frequency and help establish a feeding routine.

Sleep diary
Log every baby sleep: when fell asleep, how long slept, sleep quality. Sleep tracker shows total daily sleep time and helps build a routine. You'll see if your infant gets enough rest and how sleep patterns change over time.

Diaper tracking
Mark diaper changes and their contents. This is important for monitoring baby health: the number of wet and dirty diapers shows whether the infant is getting enough nutrition and how digestion is working.

Growth and weight
Record measurements of height, weight, head circumference. Growth charts show dynamics and help track how your baby is growing. Compare indicators with norms and share data with your pediatrician.

Growth and weight standards
Built-in standards help understand if baby weight and height correspond to age norms. You see how your infant develops compared to standard indicators for breastfed or formula-fed babies.

Sleep norms by age
Compare your baby's sleep patterns with recommended norms for their age. The app shows how much an infant should sleep at different months and helps understand if your baby is getting enough rest.

Development calendar
Track important milestones in baby development: when started holding head, rolling over, sitting, crawling. Development calendar suggests what skills appear at each age and helps not miss important moments.

Teething order
Mark the appearance of baby's first teeth and track teething order. Teething calendar shows typical sequence and timing of infant tooth appearance, helps prepare for this period.

Statistics and charts
All records about feeding, sleep, diapers are collected into visual charts. You see baby's daily routine, nursing frequency, total sleep time and can notice changes in development. This helps better understand infant needs.

Notes and reminders
Add notes about baby's wellbeing, mood, feeding or sleep specifics. Set reminders for next feeding or sleep time so you don't miss important moments.

"My Baby Tracker" - your reliable parenting assistant. Everything you need to track feeding, sleep, diapers, and development - in one place.

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

They resemble the natural sounds of the womb and thus create a calming environment for the babies they are used to.

Your baby is fed, has a clean nappy, no issues with colic, you were playing with your baby but still it is crying? The baby is probably too tired, but at the same time unable to fall asleep by itself. This is a common situation of newborns and a situation when Baby Sleep can help the most.

• Shower
• Washing machine
• Car
• Hairdryer
• Vacuum cleaner
• Shush
• Fan
• Train
• Musicbox
• Heartbeats
• Sea
