name: Elderly Care: health + protect
description:
This senior app improves a loved ones physical and mental health and well-being by helping them:
* to be more socially connected and more active (raises happiness and well-being)
* to maintain independence (help family and caregivers to remotely monitor and support them)
* to manage health and self-care (automatic popup medicine reminders…)
* to feel safe and protected (panic button, GPS tracking, motion sensor…)

This health app makes it easier for a family and caregivers to care for and get closer to their senior loved ones.

This senior care app allows people to create a closed private care group: people in the group are securely connected and are able to share and see whats happening.

How it can help you:

[1] Senior health app
This senior health app helps a person establish and maintain daily mental and physical health routines. Features sensors, daily recurring tasks and reminders to help a person improve their ability to self-care.

[2] Senior safety app & Panic button
This senior safety app uses phone/tablet sensors and home IoT sensors to monitor and detect problems. It alerts family and caregivers in the care-group. Great for senior safety. A Panic button (SOS app) works 24/7 indoors and outdoors. The GPS tracker with geo-fencing can tell you when a loved one leaves home and when they arrive back.

[3] Daily senior living
This senior citizen app allows a senior to be socially engaged, contribute to family or community, continue with activities that give life meaning, and to maintain choice and control. Automatic sensor notifications help a person to feel connected and involved with their family.

[4] Senior care app
A remote family member can receive an automatic notification telling them what time their loved one woke up (which is nice and reassuring), and more notifications throughout the day: what time they took their medicine; if they went outside for a walk, and what time a caregiver went to visit them, etc.. The app has special large icons that make it easier for a person to express the care needs and feelings.

[5] Dementia and Alzheimer’s app
If a loved one suffers from a decline in memory or confusion, perhaps Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or Parkinson’s disease, then this senior app can support daily living. You can setup tasks remotely, add notes and add photos, it will then pop-up as a notification on your loved ones phone. Great for independent living.

[6] Elderly phone app
This elderly phone app has background sensors that run 24/7 and lets family and caregivers see how much the phone/tablet device is being used and whether the battery is being kept charged,…

[7] Elderly launcher app
This elderly launcher app has large buttons for making phone calls, opening favorite websites, and clicking favorite places for Sat-Nav. So no fiddly keyboard typing. A great feature of this senior launcher app is that it can be setup remotely by family and caregivers.

[8] Caregivers app
This caregivers app helps organize care visits and enables remote caregivers to monitor and support the health & well-being of seniors with a wide range of care needs and frailty: motion sensors can monitor people with mobility and fall safety concerns; automatic care-plan popup reminders help people maintain their health and independence,…

PRIVACY
This senior citizen app works by consent - each person can chose what features to switch on and share.

SUMMARY - This senior app is designed to promote senior safety, senior health, and senior living. The app features built-in phone sensors, external home IoT sensors (due October 2021), GPS tracking and automatic geo-fence location alerts, and advanced daily recurring tasks and reminders to protect and monitor the health of an elderly person. It’s great for someone who is active and independent, and also for those with health issues, such as frailty, Alzheimer’s or Dementia, and need additional support and care. And its a senior launcher app with large buttons for phone calls and websites.

Our app is designed to help you identify irregularities, spot possible triggers, and share this information with your vet for better care. Whether you’re new to pet ownership or an experienced caregiver, Poopi offers meaningful insights that can significantly improve your pet’s quality of life. Equipped with monthly overviews and in-depth stats, you’ll have the tools to track your pet’s health trends and discuss any concerns or changes more effectively at every vet visit.

Take control of your pet’s digestive health today with Poopi, inspired by Jack and made for all pet parents!

Key Features:

* Poop Tracking: Log your dog's bowel movements quickly and easily to track date, time, and type—just like we did for Jack!

* Detailed Stats: Key stats to share with your veterinarian for improved diagnostic accuracy.

* Family & Friends Access: Share your pet’s profile with family members or friends and work together to maintain logs.

Inspired by Jack—download Poopi now!

Remember to create backup files regularly so that you don't lose them.
(Settings > Import / Export)

Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

It's possible to create your own symptom list in order to score them day after day, rating thef pain level intensity on a scale from 0 to 5.

It's also possible to record your meals, medications and add various notes, as well as your sleep schedules to highlight the causes of your symptoms. For example, it is easier to highlight the link between some of your meals and your possible stomach aches.

In addition to noting the daily evolution of the symptoms at different times of the day, it's also possible to enter an overall level of pain intensity over the course of a day in order to have a broader view of their evolution.

In short, Life-Notes offers what a simple notebook could do for you, but with a focus on tracking symptoms and providing statistics.

None of your data is sent online, 100% of your data is stored on your phone's memory.

Available languages: English, French

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. In addition, by keeping such an integrated record, trends might emerge that would otherwise go unnoticed.

PAIN IS DIFFERENT.
Pain is a subjective (not objective) sensation that you cannot measure. Its assessment relies on each person’s ability to communicate what they feel. Nanolume® developed this digital diary to help you record what you feel every day.

INCLUDED FEATURES.
For each diary entry you create:
• Choose a Pain Type. Choose from a list of predefined pain types or create a customized pain type. Next, tap the icon of the pain type you feel is most intense (you can come back and add more types later).
• Select the Intensity. Select the intensity of your pain type using a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS).
• Draw an Outline. Use your finger to draw an “outline” of the type of pain you are experiencing on the front and back sides of a generalized map of your body.
• Calculated Surface Areas. The app displays the percent [%] of your body surface affected by each (or all) of the pain types you draw.
• Zoom. Need to see a larger image of your hand or foot? Double-tap: once to zoom x2; twice to zoom x4; a third time to restore the original size.
• Notes. Tap the “Notepad” icon located in the top-left corner of each opened diary entry to record any details of your medications or treatment results.
• Tap "Add Pain." Choose another pain type (layer) to draw.
• Save Your Diary Entry. Tap "Done" to create a snapshot of all the pain type layers you drew. The app attaches the date and time your entry was saved.
• Open a Saved Entry. Tap on the date and time of the entry you want to review. Look at the intensity, location, and surface area of each pain type you experienced (by touching the icon of the pain type you want to see) or see all the pain types at once and see how they overlap (tap the "All Layers" icon). Swipe the picture left or right to check how your other pain entries compare over time.
• Charts. View a summary of your data in "Charts."
• Forget to Save an Entry? Go back and recreate a "pain picture" from the past; then, use the "Calendar" icon to backdate the recreated entry.
• Calendar Backdating. Touch the "Calendar" icon to backdate any pain-picture you draw to create a record of what you remember from the past.
• Copy/Edit. Copy or edit a copy of a previous entry.
• CSV Export. Email or save a numeric file of your data, then open that data in a spreadsheet.
• Interactive Summary & Animation. Play an animation of your data to see how your pain types change within any period you choose by selecting the corresponding start/stop dates.
• PDF Export. Export your charts, drawings, and notes as a PDF file.

PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT.
Your data is stored on your device only and not collected or stored by Nanolume® LLC. Read our End-User License Agreement and Privacy Policy at www.nanolume.com.

WHY URICA IS DIFFERENT

Traditional gout apps tell you to avoid purines. But here's what they miss: dietary purines only account for about 30% of your uric acid levels. That's why generic gout diet advice often doesn't stop flares.

Urica tracks the full picture:
★ Purines (what you expect)
★ Fructose (hidden factor that affects uric acid excretion)
★ Glycemic load (insulin spikes reduce kidney clearance)
★ Sleep, stress, and hydration patterns

Then our AI finds correlations between YOUR lifestyle and YOUR gout flares.

◆ AI Food Scanner
Photograph any meal for instant analysis. Get purine estimates, fructose content, glycemic impact, and smart swap suggestions — all in seconds.

Log gout flares with severity and location. Plus, track that "tingle" feeling before a full flare hits — your early warning system.

◆ Personal Trigger Discovery
Our AI analyzes your data over time to identify YOUR specific gout triggers. Not generic lists — patterns unique to your body.

◆ Daily Context Tracking
Log sleep quality, stress levels, and hydration. These factors significantly impact uric acid clearance and gout flare frequency.

◆ Doctor's Report
Export a comprehensive PDF with your gout flare history, dietary patterns, and AI insights to share with your healthcare team.

◆ Protective Foods
We highlight foods that help — cherries, coffee, vitamin C sources — not just what to avoid.

THE SCIENCE-BACKED APPROACH

Gout is primarily an excretion problem, not just a diet problem. Most gout patients are "under-excreters" due to metabolic factors like insulin resistance. Urica is built on this modern understanding of gout management.

We don't lecture. We don't judge. We help you become a scientist studying your own body.

name: Timeshifter Shift Work
description:

Fast Company: “Congratulations Timeshifter on helping to change the world.”

Timeshifter — Shift Work Edition — was developed to help shift workers reduce the underlying problem of circadian and sleep disruption inherent in shift work. With Timeshifter, you will receive highly personalized advice based on your sleep pattern, chronotype, work schedule, and personal preferences.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

It’s time to replace the myths with real science.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

Log every milestone of your skilled visa application — skills assessment, EOI, state nomination, visa lodgement, medicals, police checks and grant. Your timeline shows the days elapsed at each stage, and push notifications keep you on track through the whole 189, 190 or 491 process.

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

- Disease Diagnosis: detect pests, diseases & nutrient issues instantly

Whether you're rescuing a yellowing houseplant, identifying a new leaf disease, or building a watering routine for your growing collection — AI Plant Doctor has you covered.

name: ZoneSprout - US Garden Planner
description:
ZoneSprout answers one question: what can I plant, and when, where I actually live.

Tell it your state and ZIP code once. Every date in the app is then worked out from your USDA hardiness zone and your local frost dates — not copied from a calendar written for somewhere else.

WHAT IS IN IT

• Planting charts for your zone and your state. Start indoors, transplant, direct sow, bloom, harvest and prune windows, drawn across the year so you can see the whole season at once.

• Native plants for your state — the things that grew there before anyone planted them, and that the local insects and birds already know.

• Filters that match how a garden actually works. Start with the light you have — shade, part shade or full sun — then narrow by flowering, evergreen, comes back each year, native, good for pollinators, fragrant, edible, or happy in a pot. They stack, so "native shade plants that flower" is three taps.

• Collections for where you are: perennials that genuinely come back in your zone, and privacy hedges that do not die back every winter.

• A Garden Bed Planner. Lay out a bed square by square, plan your seed trays, keep a journal of what you planted with photos, and open the app to see what is worth doing this week.

WHY THE DATES DIFFER FROM OTHER APPS

Because they are not the same dates. A tomato is sown at a different time in zone 5a and zone 9b, and most planting guides quietly pick one and hope. Two gardens can share a hardiness zone and share almost nothing else — 9a in Georgia is humid and thunderstormy, 9a on the Oregon coast is cool and wet — so the state matters as much as the zone, and both go into every date.

The frost dates every calculation rests on are shown in Settings, so you can check the working rather than being asked to trust it.

Every zone from 1a to 13b. All fifty states and DC.

AN ACCOUNT AND A SUBSCRIPTION

ZoneSprout is free to download and asks you to create an account when you open it, because your beds, journal and photos belong to the account rather than to one phone — sign in on another device and your garden is already there.

Everything then opens with ZoneSprout Pro, which starts with a 7-day free trial. After the trial it is $7.99 per month or $79.99 per year. You are not charged during the trial, and cancelling any time before it ends costs nothing. Subscriptions are billed through Google Play and can be cancelled from Play Store → Subscriptions.

Cancelling never deletes a bed, a planting or a photo. It only locks the planner until you come back.

FOR GARDENS IN THE UNITED STATES

Every planting date here is calculated from US frost records, US heat history and USDA hardiness zones. If you garden outside the United States, this app cannot give you accurate dates, and we would rather say so here than take your money.

description:
Force carbonating your homemade beverage (e.g.: beer, ciders, sparkling water, sparkling wine) in your keg requires that you set the correct settings in your CO2 regulator.

This App aims to aid homebrewers in this task, by providing a list of common carbonation values, an easy to use calculator and a table of values by pressure and temperature (commonly known as a carbonation chart) where you can visually find your desired setting.

It supports imperial and metric units as well as both carbonation by volume (Volumes) and by weight (g/L).

Please note that carbonation takes time to happen and this App will only tell you what to set in your cylinder regulator, not for how long. I highly suggest that you look up the web for more information on how to force carbonate before attempting to doing so.

Follow your equipment’s instructions and pressure ratings. Use all applicable safety standards.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

name: Root Board Game
description:
Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

name: Score Counter
description:
Have you ever played a game where you needed to write down points for each player and count them up right away — and couldn't find a pen and paper at the same time?

Score Counter replaces paper, pen, and even a calculator. Just create a new game, add players with one tap, optionally set a few rules, and type in points as you play. The app handles the rest.

Whether it's board games, card games, dice games, or a pub quiz, Score Counter keeps the score for you. It's a favorite for games like Scrabble, Rummy, Yahtzee, Canasta, darts, and golf — and works with virtually any game where you add up points.

**Key Features:**
* **Game Templates:** Save your favorite game setups (players, rules, target score) and start new games in seconds.
* **Template Statistics:** Track player standings, win rates, and score trends over time. Filter by date range to see who's been on a hot streak.
* **Cloud Backup & Sync (Premium):** Sign in with Google or Apple to keep your games, players and stats safely backed up and synced across devices.
* **Advanced Game Rules:** Set a **target score** or **round limit** to automatically finish the game. Toggle **reverse scoring** for games where lower points are better. Choose a **starting player** and optionally rotate each round.
* **Initial Score:** Set a starting score for all players — perfect for games that begin with a point balance.
* **Player Rankings:** See final placements, track live ranking during the game, and resume a finished game any time.
* **Player Management:** Easily add, edit, and reorder players.
* **History:** View detailed history of all played games. Search and filter by status (still playing/finished). Check the current game leaderboard.
* **Data Export & Import:** Back up your data or analyze it on your PC. Export games (single or batch), players, and templates to **CSV** or **JSON**. Seamlessly import data back from JSON. Exported files are auto-saved to Downloads.
* **Custom Toolbars:** Create your own score input toolbars with the buttons you use most.
* **Customization:** Choose between Dark, Light, or System theme, and adjust contrast levels for better visibility.
* **Intuitive Interface:** Show or hide round numbers and interim results as needed.
* **Score Editing:** Made a mistake? Just tap a score to edit it.

Score Counter replaces pen, paper, and calculator. Focus on the game, not the math!

Found a bug? Send me an email with a short description and I'll fix it as soon as I can.

Thank you!

All trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Score Counter is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

Parchisi STAR, played by millions of players worldwide is an online multiplayer version of popular classic board game Parchis. Parchis board game is a popular in Spain as Parchis and known by different name in other countries. It is a board game of the Cross and Circle family. Ready to chill… or maybe flip the table? On Parchisi Star, compete with players globally, spill secrets on live chat or real-time voice to ""bond"" with friends 😉. Warning: this game’s the real test of friendship. It’s not for sore losers, it’s for all of us to have a blast!

Parchisi is played with two dice, four pieces per player and a board with a track around the outside, four corner spaces and four home paths leading to a central end space. The most popular Parchis boards in America has 68 spaces around the edge of the board, 12 of which are darkened safe spaces. Each corner of the board contains one player's nest or starting area.

name: Google
description:
Download the Google app to find quick answers, explore your interests, and ask anything on your mind in any way. Try AI in Google Search with AI Mode, Lens, Search Live, and more.

Feature highlights*:

• AI Mode: Get AI-powered responses to your toughest questions with AI Mode–talk, type, or snap a photo to get started, and ask follow-up questions to dig deeper. You’ll continue to see a range of helpful links so you can keep exploring across the web.
• Google Lens: See something you like? Snap a photo and discover where to shop for it, find related images, and more. Refine your camera searches by adding words – whether you want those shoes but in ‘blue’, or want to learn how to ‘repair’ that broken bit on your bicycle.
• Search Live: Have a live, real-time conversation in Search by using your voice and camera to easily get answers and on-screen links to the web when you need them.
• AI Overviews: Get a snapshot of key information about a topic or question, like ’how to fix a broken zipper’, with links so you can easily explore more on the web.
• Hum to Search: Can't remember the name of that song? Hum the tune and Google will help find it for you—no lyrics, artist name or perfect pitch required. You can also search for a song playing near you.
• Discover: Stay up-to-date on topics that matter to you. Get personalized news, articles, and videos based on your interests.
• Google Search Widget: Search faster from your home screen or lock screen, with easy shortcuts to AI Mode, Lens, and more.

Google Search, totally reimagined with AI

• Explore a new intelligent Search box that expands with your curiosity, offers AI powered suggestions and lets you search with text, videos and more.
• Bring your toughest questions to Search. With a more seamless Search experience, you can go from an AI Overview on the search results page to asking follow-up questions in AI Mode, with links to the web.
• Get help with planning, researching, brainstorming new ideas, and more with the latest Gemini models delivering frontier performance for agents and coding.
• Bring your ideas to life by transforming your photos in Lens or creating images in AI Mode with Nano Banana. Available in select languages and locations.

Search what you see with Google Lens:

• Use your camera to identify what you’re looking at. Identify plants and animals, translate text in real-time, find similar products to buy, and even solve math problems with step-by-step guides.

name: Thrift Store Story
description:
Become the manager of a pre-loved goods store (yup, that's just a fancy name for second-hand!) and turn it into a prospering business!

There are many towns for you to operate in, each with a unique customer base and different products for you to discover. You can guess what you'll find in Trendy Town or Totaltoys District, for example!

The product line-up at your store is up to you, of course. Will you be selling model toys, video games, classy suits, cars, plasma TVs, or diamonds? That's the fun in the second-hand retail industry -- you sell all sorts of goods, cherry-picked from a variety of available pre-owned products.

Your store also offers a gift-wrapping service which does wonders for boosting customer satisfaction.

Besides store shelves, you can also have stalls selling donuts or ice-cream, a gaming corner or toy vending machine. They'll draw in more customers, and once your store becomes really popular, even whole groups of kids or curious tourists.

Your field staff are in charge of collecting goods for sale. They'll sometimes come across what looks like real treasure, but you'll have to appraise it first to see what it's actually worth. You may discover some amazing items this way, which will bring fame to your store!

Fully exploring every town and finding all available products is a real challenge... Are you up for it?

name: Price Guide - U.S. Coin Values
description:
PriceGuide is the fastest way to look up what your U.S. and Canadian coins are worth.

Whether you've inherited a jar of old quarters or carefully collected key dates for years, PriceGuide gives you accurate, up-to-date prices for every grade — instantly. Open the app, find the coin, see the value. No collection to set up, no account to create.

FEATURES

• Every major U.S. coin series — from Indian Head Cents to Morgan Dollars to Saint-Gaudens Double Eagles
• Pricing for every grade, mint mark, proof, specimen, variety, and error
• Live precious-metal melt values for every silver, gold, and copper coin — from real-time spot prices
• Mintage figures so you know how rare each coin really is
• Live eBay listings to see what your coins are actually selling for
• Series Info pages with the story behind every coin design
• Composition + historical melt chart for any coin, with selectable time ranges
• Full Canadian coverage in addition to U.S.

JUNK SILVER & MELT CALCULATOR

The Metals tab shows current silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices alongside the melt value of popular coins:
• 90% silver dimes, quarters, halves, and dollars
• 40% silver Kennedy halves (1965–1970)
• War nickels (1942–1945)
• American Silver Eagles
• Pre-1933 gold ($2.50 / $5 / $10 / $20)
• American Gold Eagles and Gold Buffalos
• Pre-1982 Lincoln cents and large copper coinage

Tap any coin or spot price to see composition, weight, per-metal value, and a melt-value chart you can scrub through.

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS FOR

• Looking up what a coin is worth before selling
• Checking key date premiums (1909-S VDB, 1916-D Mercury, 1893-S Morgan) at a glance
• Estimating melt value on junk silver, war nickels, pre-1933 gold, and copper cents
• Verifying mintage and rarity before bidding on eBay
• Pricing inherited coin collections without a dealer visit

WHAT PRICEGUIDE IS NOT

PriceGuide is a price reference, not a collection tracker. To catalog the coins you own — grades, purchase prices, completion progress, portfolio value — use our sibling app LuckyCoin. PriceGuide is for the moment you just need to know "what is this worth, right now."

PRICEGUIDE PREMIUM

Unlock the full app:
• Pricing for every grade (free tier shows two)
• Live spot prices on the Metals tab (free tier shows a one-week-old snapshot)
• Proof and specimen pricing
• Variety and error pricing
• Pricing for Proof Sets and Mint Sets

Subscribe monthly or yearly, or unlock everything once with a Lifetime purchase. Cancel anytime in Settings.

FREQUENTLY ASKED

Q: How accurate are the prices?
A: The database refreshes regularly from auction and dealer data. Actual sale prices vary by grade, eye appeal, and certification.

Q: Does PriceGuide track my collection?
A: No — it's a price lookup reference. For collection tracking, use LuckyCoin.

Q: Are melt values accurate?
A: Yes. Calculated from real-time silver, gold, platinum, and copper spot prices using each coin's actual composition and weight.

Q: Free or paid?
A: Free with two grade points per coin. Premium unlocks every grade, varieties, errors, proofs, and live melt values.

Q: Privacy?
A: No account required. We don't track your lookups or sell your data.

Made by Stuck at Home, LLC — also behind LuckyCoin (coin tracker), LuckyFind (metal detecting log), LuckyVinyl (records), and the Lucky family of utility and collector apps.

Visit getluckycoin.com for free coin guides on key dates, error coins, grading, and silver melt.

MEAL PLANNER

Your plan becomes a grocery list, grouped by aisle and scaled to how many people are eating. Tick items off with one thumb while you shop. Add the milk that belongs to no recipe. Editing the shopping list never changes the meals it came from.

RECIPE KEEPER
Paste a link and Farro reads the ingredients and the steps. You see exactly what it read, and you fix it before saving. Your recipes stay yours — no locked library, no paywalled cookbook, nothing rewritten behind your back. A recipe keeper, not a recipe feed.

MEAL PREP AND REPEATS
Copy any week onto another one. The week that worked last month is one tap from being next week's plan. Sunday cooking, batch cooking, or just Wednesday's dinner — the planner does not care how you cook, it only remembers what you chose.

YOUR WEEK CANNOT DISAPPEAR
No account, no server, no login. Everything is stored on your phone, so there is nothing to sign into and no outage that empties the week you already cooked. Export all of it to a file whenever you want — free, subscriber or not.

HOW FARRO WORKS
1. Answer a few questions about your week. Every step is skippable.
2. Add meals to any day, or paste a recipe link.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE FARRO

— A grocery list that builds itself from the week, sorted by aisle.
— A recipe keeper that shows you what it imported before it saves it.
— Works offline: plan on the train, shop in the basement aisle.
— Metric or imperial on the shopping list, your choice.
— English and Spanish.
— Adult, readable design. No cartoons.
— Your data is yours: a full export, any time, free.

PRICING PLANS
Free:

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

description:

With simple controls, you can enter ingredients and adjust their amounts as needed. Want to halve or third a recipe? Just tap the 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 or x2 buttons. For other ratios, you can enter a percentage manually.

■ Copy your results
Select “Copy to Clipboard” from the menu to copy your calculation results as text. You can paste and save recipes into your favorite recipe app or use them to create a shopping list.

■ Recalculate with What You Have
Just enter the amount you have for one ingredient, and the app will automatically adjust the rest!
Perfect for when the recipe says "200g," but you only have 190g on hand.

■Save and Search Recipes
Save the recipes you enter and quickly bring them up anytime you need them.

■ Recalculate later
If you’ve saved the copied data, simply copy it again and use the “Import from clipboard” menu in this app to reload it.

■ Customize data separators
You can choose how ingredients, amounts, and units are separated (tab or space) in the settings menu. When importing from the clipboard, the app automatically detects the format.

■ Reorder Ingredients with Drag & Drop
You can now press and hold an ingredient to move it to your preferred position using drag and drop.

● How to use

1. Enter ingredients
Tap “Add” and enter up to 10 ingredients. The recipe name is optional.

2. Enter scaling ratio
Tap the “Ratio” field to input how much to scale the recipe. You can also use the 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 or x2 buttons next to the field for quick access.

3. Edit or delete ingredients
Tap the pencil icon next to an ingredient to edit or delete it.

4. Clear all ingredients
Tap the “Clear” button to delete all entered ingredients at once.

5. Save Your Recipe
Tap the “Save” button. To open a saved recipe, select “My Recipes” from the menu.

6. Copy and import recipe data
Select “Copy to Clipboard” from the menu to copy the ingredient data to the clipboard in the following format:

Recipe Name
Ingredient Amount Unit

(Do not include <> in the input.)

You can choose tab or space as the separator in the settings. Copy text data in the same format, then select “Import from Clipboard” menu to load it as ingredient data. The recipe name is optional.

7. Recalculate by Setting a New Amount
Tap on the amount shown after the ingredients are calculated.
Enter a new amount, and the rest of the ingredients will be recalculated automatically.

The app finds the closest possible ratio to your input, so you might sometimes see results like "149.99g" when you enter "150g."

8. Reordering Ingredients
Press and hold an ingredient to start dragging it. A blue line will appear to show where it will be dropped — simply release it at your desired position.

MealMate exists for a single reason, to help you achieve your physical goals by providing practical meal plans you can actually follow.

We know it’s challenging to fit a meal plan into your life. Every day can be different, and most meal plans only offer standardized options with little to no flexibility.

But not MealMate!

Our meal plans are as individual as you.

When calculating meal plans, our Meal Mate algorithm not only takes into account your calorie-, protein-, carbs-, and fat-targets, but also how many times per day you want to eat.

MealMate automatically generates meal plans for you that support you with your goals, from building muscle to losing fat. It doesn’t matter when and how many times you want to eat per day. MealMate is highly customizable and generates meal plans tailored to you.

Simple calorie trackers only help you track your calories. But that’s only a fraction of the work. The hard part is deciding what to eat to ensure that you reach your desired macros for the day. That’s where we help you.

***Highlight Features***

MACRO MEAL PLAN GENERATION
Meal plans are a great tool if you want to lose fat, build muscle, and live a healthier life. MealMate calculates your macros and calories and provides you with a meal plan that matches your macros. You can also easily adapt your macros and calories manually.
Don’t like the meal plan? Simply regenerate the whole day or change single meals.

HIGH CUSTOMIZABILITY
We offer a very high degree of customizability when generating your meal plan to ensure that it works for you. Do you want to build habits and repeat specific meals every day? Just insert them into your template and our algorithm will build a meal plan around your set meals. We also don’t force a structure on you. You decide how many meals you want to eat per day.

HANDPICKED RECIPES
Healthy and delicious meals are the heart of every meal plan. Our continuously growing database of over 500 handpicked recipes offers many breakfast, dinner, lunch, snack, or dessert options. Additionally, select whether our meal plan should take any allergies or other dietary restrictions into account. We’ll only show you the meals that match your eating habits.


***Feature Overview***
- Get meal plans based on your calorie and macro targets
- Easily regenerate the day if you don’t like our suggestion
- Change single meals with our easy shuffle function
- No limitations: Supports many different diet styles (omnivore, vegetarian,
vegan, keto, pescatarian, …) and allergies
- Everybody’s eating habits are different: You decide how often and at which
times you want to eat
- Simplicity is key to a successful diet: Set fixed meals for specific days and
times
- Easily transform your meal plan into a shopping list
- Copy your meal plan to other days if you want to repeat the day
- Block meals you don’t like
- Track your progress with voluntary weight-ins to stay motivated
- Be consistent with the meal plan to build a streak
- Customize the algorithm to your preferences. Do you prefer a plan that
focuses on reaching your target macros or do you prefer more variability in
your diet?

name: Prompted Journal - Shadow Work
description:
Prompted is a guided journal: a private diary that asks you a question every day, so the writing starts before the blank page can stop you.

It is built for reflection, introspection and personal growth through carefully crafted daily prompts — not just recording how you feel, but giving the feeling somewhere to go. Wellness living, manifestation and shadow work all start from the same place: a question you would not have asked yourself.

WHAT'S INSIDE

- 190+ guided journal prompts for reflection, introspection and shadow work.
- A five minute habit: one daily question, one honest answer.
- "Dive Deeper" follow-up questions on every prompt, for the days you want to keep going.
- Write your own prompts and keep them alongside the catalog.
- A private diary with a biometric lock. Your writing stays yours.
- Daily reminders that keep the habit going.
- A free quote of the day to open each entry.
- Use it as a gratitude journal, a mood diary, a dream diary or a guided journal — whatever your daily writing practice needs.

WHY A GUIDED JOURNAL

A blank page is the hardest part of keeping a diary. A guided journal with writing prompts gives every entry a starting point, so reflection happens even on the days when you have nothing to say. Dedicate five minutes and the practice becomes a routine that supports personal growth, so you can focus on what matters: understanding your inner self.

SHADOW WORK AND INTROSPECTION

Shadow work is the part of journaling that asks about the things you normally steer around. Prompted approaches it the same way it approaches everything else — with a question rather than a blank page. Use the introspective prompts to explore the parts of yourself you tend not to write about, and pair them with mood check-ins and gratitude entries so the practice stays balanced. A shadow work journal only works if you actually open it, which is what the daily question is for.

FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE BOUNCED OFF JOURNALING

If you have downloaded a journal app before, written twice and stopped, the problem was probably never discipline — it was the empty screen. A daily question removes the hardest decision. Answer it, close the app, come back tomorrow. That is the whole loop, and it is why a guided diary survives ordinary weeks when a blank one does not.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Entries live behind a biometric lock, and your diary stores its entries in local app storage on your device. No account is required: there is no sign-up and no email address to hand over.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a PDF or a CSV through your device's share controls. PDF export is quota-limited on the free tier; premium removes the limit.

FREE AND PREMIUM

Prompted is free to download and the daily practice is free to use. Premium opens the rest of the prompt catalog and lifts the export quota. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY WRITING PRACTICE

Some people keep Prompted as a self care diary, some as a shadow work journal, some as a reflection app, some as a plain daily record with a question attached. The prompt is the point: it makes the practice repeatable on the ordinary days, which are most of them.

name: Three Good Things - Gratitude
description:
Three Good Things is a simple gratitude journal for the end of the day — a private daily diary for positivity, mood and calm.

Every evening, write down three good things that happened and how each one made you feel. That is the whole practice. Write them, then put the phone down.

Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology.

WHAT THE APP DOES

- Three good things a day. Short entries, not essays.
- The "I felt" prompt. After each good thing, note the feeling that came with it.
- Memories. Re-read past entries and watch your good days collect over months and years.
- A daily reminder at a time you choose.
- A quote each day.
- Themes, including a night mode for reading in bed.
- Works as a mood diary too: the feelings you note build a quiet record of your moods over the months.

PRIVACY

- No account is required. There is no sign-up, and no email address to hand over.
- Journal entries are stored locally in app storage. Exporting or sharing creates a copy through your device's share controls.
- No ads. No AI.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a CSV that can be imported later, or a PDF readable archive. Premium includes unlimited exports; the free app includes three.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The daily practice is free. Premium adds decorative themes and a polished PDF keepsake. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY GRATITUDE HABIT

Three short entries make a five minute gratitude practice. Done nightly, the gratitude journal becomes a daily habit of noticing — a small act of self care before bed. Some people keep it alongside a longer diary or a mood tracker; this journal only ever asks for the good things, so being grateful stays easy.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

The three good things exercise asks you to name three things that went well and your part in them. It has been studied in positive psychology, and it is deliberately small: the point is that it is easy enough to do on an ordinary evening.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who have started a journal before and stopped. If a blank page has ever felt like homework, this daily diary asks for a good deal less: three good things, a feeling for each, done.

Download Three Good Things and start your gratitude journal tonight — a simple daily journaling practice for a more grateful evening.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

name: KnowDrugs Drug Checking
description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. This is especially useful if you have a to do list with repeating tasks or if you want to be reminded to do the same thing every day. It can also be used as a calendar planning tool or checklist, but also as a very effective repeating reminder (e.g. to drink water every 2 hours).

HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
It is entirely up to you, really. But why not give it a try and have a convenient helper on the go?

• 100% offline by default
• Lightweight, fast and battery friendly

Share or paste a product link and Return Reminder extracts the title, image, price and return window automatically. Supported stores: Amazon, AliExpress, SHEIN, Temu, Zalando, Zara, IKEA, MediaMarkt, Decathlon, El Corte Inglés, Fnac, PcComponentes, ASOS, H&M, Adidas, Nike, Joom, Best Buy, Walmart, Target, eBay, Etsy and more.

Get reminded before every return deadline with notifications at 14, 7, 3 and 1 day before expiry (Pro). Choose your reminder time in Settings. No more "I should have returned that last week".

• Total spent and money currently at risk
• Money recovered by returning on time
• Returns made and missed

1. Tap + and paste a product link, or fill it in manually.
2. Return Reminder calculates the exact last day you can return the item.
3. Get timely notifications before the deadline arrives.
4. Mark the product as Returned or Kept and watch your savings grow.

• Unlimited active products (free version supports up to 5)
• No ads

Your purchases are personal. Return Reminder stores everything locally by default. Cloud sync is fully optional. Manage ad consent and read the Privacy Policy from Settings any time.

★ PERFECT FOR ★
• Online shoppers buying from multiple stores
• Fashion lovers ordering several sizes to try at home
• Tech enthusiasts buying electronics with long return windows
• Gift buyers who need flexibility
• Anyone who hates losing money to forgotten refunds

Take control of your online shopping with Return Reminder & Tracker — the ultimate return deadline tracker, refund reminder and money saver for Android. Download today and never miss a return again. Your wallet will thank you.

CALCULATION METHODS:
Temperature Delta Method — CFM from BTU load and supply/return temperature difference
Duct Velocity Method — CFM from duct size (round or rectangular) and air velocity (FPM)
Sensible Heat Method — CFM from sensible cooling/heating capacity and temperature delta
Total Heat Method — CFM from total heat load and enthalpy difference

Round & Rectangular Duct Support — Both duct shapes in velocity calculations
Cross-Check Verification — Use multiple CFM methods to validate calculations
Instant Results — Airflow, velocity, and duct area displayed in real-time

name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.

Web version: calc.ashrae-meteo.info

description:
Llama Life is a daily task planner and organizer, designed to help you focus on ONE task at a time - so you're not just making lists, you're actually getting THROUGH them!

Llama Life let’s you set a countdown timer for *every* task. This concept is called ‘timeboxing’, and the idea is to create a (positive) constraint around the time we have to do something. The goal is to try and give a task 100% of our attention, until the timer runs out. This helps to increase focus, and gives us the mental space to think about ONE thing at a time.

Llama Life also let’s you know your total List Time, and the estimated finishing time, so you can be more aware of time passing, and plan your day.

We also love celebrating the wins, big or small, so very importantly, you get confetti (woo hoo!) when you finish a task. You can also personalize with color and emoji to get lots of variety and keep things fun and fresh!

Llama Life offers a 7-day free trial, with a Monthly or Annual subscription.

All the best,

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.

name: Extrovert or Introvert Test
description:
This test measures the personality trait of extraversion.

Personality traits are relatively stable over time, but they can and often do gradually change as you age.

People who are more extraverted tend to feel energized by social interactions, enjoy meeting and socializing with people, and are often the center of attention. They are often perceived as outgoing, social, full of energy, enthusiastic, and action-oriented.

People who are more introverted tend to feel drained by social interactions, prefer a good amount of solitude, and dislike small talk. They are often perceived as quiet, low-key, and deliberate. They need less stimulation and more time alone than extraverts.

name: Introvert - Be Social
description:
Embracing your inner extrovert might feel like stepping into uncharted territory, but fear not! Becoming more social is an exciting journey that begins with simple steps, gradually leading to newfound confidence and sociability.

Start by taking baby steps into the world of social interactions. Begin with small talk; strike up a conversation with a friendly neighbor, a co-worker, or someone waiting in line. Practice active listening - it's an art that helps you connect more deeply with others.

Challenge yourself to attend social gatherings or events. It might feel daunting at first, but remember, each experience is a chance to grow. Push your comfort zone a little each time. Maybe set a goal to attend one social event a week, or even a month, to start with.

Join clubs or groups that align with your interests. Whether it's a book club, a hiking group, or a cooking class, being around like-minded individuals can make socializing feel more natural and enjoyable.

Practice positive self-talk. Encourage yourself along the way. Acknowledge your progress and celebrate the little victories. Remember, Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither is the confident extrovert version of yourself!

Lastly, be patient and kind to yourself. Transforming into a more social butterfly takes time. Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither will your social prowess. Each step you take, no matter how small, is a stride toward a more confident and outgoing you.

So, get ready to spread your wings and dive into the wonderful world of social interactions. You've got this!

name: Last Time Tracker – DoneAgo
description:
Ever forget how long it's been since you did something, and just can't remember? DoneAgo is a last-time tracker built especially for people with time blindness or ADHD, so you always know exactly how long it's been, without having to guess or hold it in your head.

Simple, tap-based tracking
Tap a button after you do something, so you always know when it happened. This helps you decide if it's time to take action or if it can wait. Useful for managing plants, pets, chores, and everyday things around the house.

Your own states, your own words
Set up states or actions that make sense to you, like Cleaned or Dirty, Fed or Not Fed, or just a simple Done. You decide what matters and how it's tracked.

Notes on every update
Add a short note to any state change, so you don't just remember when it happened, you remember why or what happened too. Maybe you skipped watering the plant on purpose, or the vet visit took longer than usual. A quick note gives you the context behind the update, so it actually makes sense later, not just a timestamp with no story behind it.

Auto-advance
Some things need attention based on when you last did them, like taking medicine, or changing a filter. Set a time limit on a state, and once it runs out, DoneAgo switches it for you automatically. Nothing to remember, nothing to set again.

Home screen widgets
Update a tracker straight from your home screen. See how long it's been without even opening the app.

Smart notifications
Get notified only when something's stayed the same for too long. You set the limit, DoneAgo handles the rest.

Full history
See your whole timeline in one place. Patterns show up naturally once you can actually see them.

Custom groups
Organize cards into groups like Home, Pets, Health, or anything you want to set up.

Ad-free and private
No ads, no trackers, no distractions. Just the app and your data.

Stop trying to remember. Open DoneAgo, look, and know.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

Privacy Policy: https://www.askdiem.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.askdiem.com/terms-of-service

name: Open Food Facts
description:
🔍 Scan, Discover & Compare Over 4 Million Food Products


The app allows to scan the 4 million products already contained in the free and open database Open Food Facts.
The app is collaborative. If we don't have the product, you can add pictures and data to get the Nutri-Score and NOVA score on food processing.

In short, we're kind of "the Wikipedia of food", as many have nicknamed the project. Open Food Facts has enabled the creation of over 100 apps like Date Limite, Yuka or FoodVisor.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

🌍 Join Our Mission for Food Transparency



➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.
➜ You can start contributing today by adding a product from your fridge.
➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts


➜ Milk, Gluten, Eggs, Soybeans, Nuts, Fish, Celery, Mustard, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites, Peanuts, Sesame seeds, Crustaceans, Molluscs or Lupin allergy ?
➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.
➜ Be careful that the information may not be 100% accurate, and detection may not be 100% accurate. So always double check by yourself, with the packaging.

💰 Open Prices: Transparency on Food Costs
